newsitem.title: USA: Suit filed for Advanced Voice shareholders.
newsitem.headline: Suit filed for Advanced Voice shareholders.

text.p: Three law firms said Wednesday they filed a class action lawsuit in U.S. District Court in New York on behalf of all persons who acquired shares of Advanced Voice Technologies Inc from February 6,1995 through October 8, 1996.

The complaint charges the retail brokerage firm of Sterling Foster and Co Inc and another party with manipulation of the price of Advanced Voice stock, which resulted in the plaintiff and other members of the class purchasing Advanced Voice shares at artificially inflated prices.
Sterling Foster could not immediately be reached for comment.
The firms representing the plaintiff are Goodkind Labaton Rudoff & Sucharow LLP, Hanzman Criden Korge Hertzberg & Chaykin and Wolf Haldenstein Alder Freeman & Herz LLP.
